# TestRunner domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-70f176589bcc

TestRunner runs a mod's in-game tests in the real game with nobody at the keyboard. A launcher builds the mod's test project, checks it with ModCheck, starts the game with `--onitest-dir=DIR --onitest-save=FILE`, and the harness mod loads a fixture save, runs every `[OniTest]` coroutine found in `DIR/tests/*.dll`, writes one JSON line per test and a status line, and quits (or stays up for the next run). Tests drive the game the way a player does: the real `InterfaceTool` fed the calls the player controller makes (layer 1), with the game's own API for setup and oracles (layer 0). It is a development tool, not for the Workshop, and inert without its arguments. The user-facing guide is `README.md`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-978685bb1f6f

### TestRunnerMod
**Id:** blk-12154230c41b  
**Description**: the entry point (`UserMod2`). Reads the command line, sets the crash-reporter flags, adds the assembly resolver that lets test assemblies find the mods under test and this harness, and traces quits.  
**Location**: `Mod.cs`  
**Relationships**: calls `Session.ReadCommandLine`; the patches in `Patches.cs`, `Worldgen.cs` and `Diagnostics.cs` are applied by `base.OnLoad`.

### Session
**Id:** blk-7f9302c43486  
**Description**: command line, state and results of a session.  
**Location**: `Session.cs`

| Member | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `Active`, `Started`, `Finished` | session flags; `Active` needs `--onitest-dir` and `--onitest-save` |
| `Dir`, `SavePath`, `Filters`, `TimeoutSeconds`, `TestTimeoutSeconds`, `Keep`, `Trace`, `ServerDir` | the options |
| `Tests`, `NextIndex` | the selected tests and the next to run; survive a scene change |
| `Passed`, `Failed`, `Errors`, `Timeouts`, `Skipped`, `Reloads` | counters for the status line |
| `Discover()` | loads every DLL in `DIR/tests` from its bytes and lists `[OniTest]` methods, sorted by assembly, class and declaration order |
| `Start()`, `Continue()`, `WriteOff()` | begin a run; move to the next test's world or fixture; record tests as not run |
| `Write(result)`, `Finish(status, detail)` | append a result; write the status and quit or go idle |
| `PollQueue()`, `WriteState()` | live-session requests and state file |

### TestCase and TestResult
**Id:** blk-18187e3cb8c6  
**Description**: a discovered test method (id, name, timeout, layer and the attribute flags) and what one test produced (one `results.jsonl` line).  
**Location**: `Session.cs`

### TestBehaviour
**Id:** blk-49587b759cd2  
**Description**: a `MonoBehaviour` on the Game object (or on a driver object for a no-colony run). Waits for the HUD, throws the harness switches, finds and clears the fixture area, then runs each test as a hand-stepped coroutine with a real-time deadline, captures logged errors, runs cleanups and writes the result.  
**Location**: `TestBehaviour.cs` (`LogCapture` in the same file)

### Patches
**Id:** blk-6e02b4b02569  
**Description**: Harmony patches, each inert unless `Session.Active`.  
**Location**: `Patches.cs`

| Patch | Does |
|-------|------|
| `MainMenu_OnSpawn_Patch` | notes when the menu appeared |
| `App_LateUpdate_Patch` | four seconds after the menu: starts the session; drives worldgen; session timeout; polls the live queue |
| `Game_OnSpawn_Patch` | adds `TestBehaviour` when the colony is up |
| `SaveLoader_Save_Patch`, `Game_StartDelayedSave_Patch` | block saves outside the run folder; skip autosave |
| `App_Quit_Patch` | logs who quit |
| `Manager_MatchFootprint_Patch`, `Manager_Report_Patch` | no "mod differences" or "mod events" dialogs |
| `GameFlowManager_CheckForGameOver_Patch` | no "colony lost" screen on a fixture with no Duplicants |
| `KInputManager_OnApplicationFocus_Patch`, `InterfaceTool_OnApplicationFocus_Patch` | force the focus flags back on |

### Harness
**Id:** blk-052ae0295b17  
**Description**: the global switches of a run: focus forced on, mouse position locked (parked in the bottom right corner between tests), physical keyboard and mouse ignored, instant build on, speed 1, tool reset, camera look-at.  
**Location**: `Harness.cs`

### FixtureArea
**Id:** blk-633dd6387bca  
**Description**: the 40 by 10 rectangle of the active world that tests build in: fully revealed and buildable, with the most empty cells (cells underground count double). Cleared before the first test and after every test (objects, loose items, solid cells; Duplicants are the test's to remove). `Dupes.Box` walls it for Duplicant tests.  
**Location**: `FixtureArea.cs`

### Worldgen and GeneratedWorld
**Id:** blk-9e3323c536e4  
**Description**: tests marked `[OniTest(Worldgen = "COORD")]` run in a world freshly generated from that coordinate: the harness goes to the main menu, applies the coordinate, runs the game's worldgen screen, embarks, then runs the test. Consecutive tests with one coordinate share the world. `GeneratedWorld` records the coordinate, the applied coordinate, the cluster, worldgen errors and seconds.  
**Location**: `Worldgen.cs`

### Reflect and Diagnostics
**Id:** blk-741c81a8a7c1

**Description**: `Reflect` is the list of private game members the kit and tests use, with `SelfCheck`; `Worldgen.cs` reads two buttons with its own `AccessTools.Field` calls. `Diagnostics` traces the grid marks the game makes during tests (`--onitest-trace=1`).  
**Location**: `Reflect.cs`, `Diagnostics.cs`

### The kit (`Isochronous.TestKit`)
**Id:** blk-c6e1619a47bb  
**Description**: what a test author uses.  
**Location**: `Kit/`

| Type | File | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| `OniTestAttribute`, `LayerAttribute` | `Attributes.cs` | mark tests and set their options (`Timeout`, `FreshSave`, `Explicit`, `Boxed`, `NoColony`, `Worldgen`) |
| `OniAssertException`, `SkipException` | `Attributes.cs` | thrown by `t.Assert` and `t.Skip` |
| `TestContext` | `TestContext.cs` | `Assert`, `World`, `Tools`, `Dupes`, waits (`Frames`, `WaitGameSeconds`, `WaitRealSeconds`, `WaitUntil`), `Rect`, `Area`, `Log`, `Cleanup`, `AllowLogError`, `Skip`, `Speed`, `InstantBuild`, `ResearchAll`, `Screenshot`, `Press`, `PointAt`, `LookAt`, `Generated` |
| `Wait` and its subclasses, `CellRect` | `TestContext.cs` | what a test yields; a rectangle of cells |
| `OniAssert` | `OniAssert.cs` | `True`, `False`, `Eq`, `NotEq`, `Null`, `NotNull`, `Has`, `Lacks`, `Fail` |
| `World`, `Cells` | `World.cs` | `Build`, `At`, `Destroy`, `LogicNetwork`, `LogicConnections` at layer 0; cell descriptions |
| `Tools`, `UtilityDragSession` | `Tools.cs` | the real utility build tool at layer 1: `Path`, `Sweep`, `PreviewTint`, `PreviewValid` |
| `Dupes` | `Dupes.cs` | `Box`, `ClearBox`, `Spawn`, `Grant`, `GrantAll`, `Drop`, `Remove`, `RemoveAll` |
| `SaveFile` | `SaveFile.cs` | `Capture` and `Restore` a building through the game's own save and load |

### Invoke-OniTests.ps1
**Id:** blk-5b0c52216ccc  
**Description**: the launcher. For each mod in `-Mods`, finds `src/<Mod>.Tests/<Mod>.Tests.csproj` (in a repo or under `mods/`), builds it, checks the test DLL with `tools/ModCheck`, copies it into the run folder, rewrites `mods.json` so only TestRunner, the mods under test, `-With` and `-Steam` are enabled, launches the game through Steam (or hands the run to a live game), waits for the status, prints a line per test and exits with its code.  
**Location**: `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`  
**Options**: `-Mods` (required), `-Filter`, `-Fixture`, `-With`, `-Steam`, `-TimeoutSec`, `-TestTimeoutSec`, `-KeepGame`, `-BuildOnly`, `-NoBuild`, `-NoCheck`, `-BuildArgs`, `-Label`, `-Trace`, `-OutDir`, `-SteamExe`, `-AppId`.

### Watch-OniGame.ps1
**Id:** blk-5f4f98f50aec  
**Description**: the warden of a live session, started detached next to the game. Waits for the game to exit, restores `mods.json` from the backup, removes the live-session folder; ends a game that stops answering.  
**Location**: `Watch-OniGame.ps1`

### Files
**Id:** blk-aabf5834e2e4

| File | Direction | Purpose |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `DIR/tests/*.dll` | read | the test assemblies |
| `DIR/results.jsonl`, `results.jsonl.status` | written by the game | per-test results; the session status |
| `DIR/artifacts/*.png` | written by the game | `t.Screenshot` output |
| fixture save | read | copied to the run folder as `fixture.sav`; never written back |
| `Documents\Klei\OxygenNotIncluded\mods\mods.json` | rewritten, restored | the run's loadout; backup `mods.json.onitest-backup` |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\IsochronousOniTests\live` | read, written | live-session queue, state and pid |

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-ad9c4a3b39af

- Without `--onitest-dir` and `--onitest-save` the mod changes nothing.
- No save goes to disk outside the run folder, and the game's autosave is skipped.
- A test is `public static IEnumerator M(TestContext t)` with `[OniTest]`; any other signature with the attribute fails the session at discovery.
- Tests run in order of assembly name, class, declaration. An `Explicit` test runs only when `-Filter` selects it.
- Any `Error`, `Exception` or `Assert` the game logs during a test fails it unless `t.AllowLogError` allows it.
- Each mod's tests start on a fresh load of the fixture; `[OniTest(FreshSave = true)]` loads it again before a test, after a settle of five game seconds.
- A run is handed to a live game only when the loadout matches: the mode, the mods, `-With`, `-Steam`, `-Trace` and every file of each deployed local mod, the harness and their shared configs. Anything else ends the game and launches a new one.
- The game stays up 15 s after a run for another; one run at a time per machine.
- A world coordinate of the other game mode skips its tests.
- A run needs Steam running and the game not running (apart from its own live session).

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-8a2f716a53ff

- **Launch**: `Invoke-OniTests.ps1` builds, runs ModCheck, writes `mods.json`, starts or hands over to the game. See `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`.
- **Start**: `MainMenu.OnSpawn` postfix, then `App.LateUpdate` postfix calls `Session.Start`: `Discover`, then `Continue` loads the fixture (`LoadScreen.DoLoad`) or asks for a world. See `Patches.cs`, `Session.cs`.
- **Run**: `Game.OnSpawn` postfix adds `TestBehaviour`; `RunAll` picks the area, clears it and steps each test with `RunOne`. See `TestBehaviour.cs`.
- **Generated world**: `Worldgen.Begin` at the main menu, `Worldgen.Embark` after the colony spawns. See `Worldgen.cs`.
- **End**: `Session.Finish` writes the status and quits or goes idle; the launcher reads `results.jsonl` and the status and exits. See `Session.cs`, `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`.
- **Live session**: `Session.PollQueue` takes `<run>.req`, `Session.Begin` resets and starts again. See `Session.cs`.

## State Transitions
**Id:** blk-27f068ae61ee

| State | Transitions To | Trigger |
|-------|---------------|---------|
| test pending | pass, fail, error, timeout, skipped | the driver steps it (see [error handling](../standards/error-handling.md)) |
| session busy | idle | `Session.Finish` in a live session |
| session idle | busy | a request in `queue` |
| session idle | quitting | `quit.req`, or 15 s with no request |

## Related
**Id:** blk-ac2e0e4164d8

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)
- Governed by: [naming conventions](../standards/naming-conventions.md)

# TestRunner glossary

Terms a newcomer to TestRunner needs. Entity detail is in [entities](entities.md).

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-f88dca2a1b27

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | the game |
| SO | Spaced Out | the expansion; its mode loads `testbed-so.sav`, the only fixture supplied |
| HUD | heads-up display | the driver waits up to 60 s for it before the first test |
| DLL | test assembly | `<Mod>.Tests.dll`, copied to `DIR/tests` |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-d5cc7906d14d

### Harness
**Id:** blk-0c81d2ef6d47  
**Definition**: the TestRunner mod itself: the code in the game that loads the fixture, steps tests and reports. Versus the kit, which is what tests call.  
**Used in**: `Harness.cs`, `README.md`.

### Kit
**Id:** blk-cddba398d1da  
**Definition**: `Isochronous.TestKit` in `Kit/`: the test context, assertions, attributes and helpers a test project references.  
**Used in**: every test project.

### Fixture
**Id:** blk-4199508c4e2e

**Definition**: the save a run loads: `fixtures/testbed-so.sav` in Spaced Out mode (the only fixture supplied), `fixtures/testbed-base.sav` in base-game mode (copy it in first), or the `-Fixture` path: sandbox on, no Duplicants, revealed map. Tests never change the file; the launcher copies it into the run folder.  
**Used in**: `Session.Continue`, the launcher.

### Fixture area
**Id:** blk-a0cfe36dee6e  
**Definition**: the 40 by 10 window of the active world that the harness picks and clears for tests (`FixtureArea`); `t.Rect(w, h)` gives a clear rectangle inside it with a one-cell margin.  
**Used in**: `FixtureArea.cs`, `TestContext`.

### Layer
**Id:** blk-46885449ff2a  
**Definition**: where a test drives the game: 0 the game's API, 1 the tool (real `InterfaceTool` input), 2 UI, 3 input. Recorded with `[Layer(n)]` and in the results; layers 2 and 3 are not built.  
**Used in**: `LayerAttribute`, `TestResult`.

### Run, session and live session
**Id:** blk-be133b9156d5  
**Definition**: a run is one launcher invocation's tests. A session is one game process taking runs. A live session is a game that stays up 15 s after a run and takes the next one with the same loadout from its queue.  
**Used in**: `Session.cs`, the launcher, `Watch-OniGame.ps1`.

### Warden
**Id:** blk-17051b9bdfa7  
**Definition**: `Watch-OniGame.ps1`, the detached process that restores `mods.json` and clears the live-session folder when the game exits.  
**Used in**: the launcher, `Watch-OniGame.ps1`.

### Wait
**Id:** blk-12fc1ae73c38  
**Definition**: an object a test yields (`t.Frames`, `t.WaitGameSeconds`, `t.WaitRealSeconds`, `t.WaitUntil`); the driver polls it once per frame against the test's deadline and fails the test with its description when it times out.  
**Used in**: `Kit/TestContext.cs`, `TestBehaviour.cs`.

### Box
**Id:** blk-40af48693237  
**Definition**: the Duplicants' box: tiles walling the fixture area with air inside and a dev life support, made by `t.Dupes.Box()`; `[OniTest(Boxed = true)]` keeps it between consecutive tests.  
**Used in**: `Kit/Dupes.cs`, `FixtureArea.cs`.

### Loadout
**Id:** blk-90066b0e7a52  
**Definition**: the list of enabled mods in `mods.json`. A run enables only TestRunner, the mods under test, `-With` and `-Steam`; the player's is backed up and restored.  
**Used in**: the launcher, the warden.

### Generated world
**Id:** blk-4d6d5f72d7c2  
**Definition**: a world made fresh from a coordinate such as `SNDST-C-100-0-0-0` (the letter before the seed is `C` for Spaced Out, `A` for base game) for tests with `Worldgen = ...`.  
**Used in**: `Worldgen.cs`.

### Self-check
**Id:** blk-14e9c9072d5c  
**Definition**: `Reflect.SelfCheck()`, run before the first test, listing the private game members that no longer resolve.  
**Used in**: `Reflect.cs`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-db910f4597a3

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# TestRunner

## What this is
**Id:** blk-666b8641eaaa

TestRunner runs an Oxygen Not Included mod's in-game tests in the real game with nobody at the keyboard. It has two halves. The harness is a development-only mod (`Isochronous.TestRunner`, version 0.1.0 in `mod_info.yaml`, minimum build 744825, not for the Workshop): started with `--onitest-dir=DIR --onitest-save=FILE`, it loads a fixture save, blocks saves outside `DIR`, runs every `[OniTest]` coroutine in `DIR/tests/*.dll`, writes one JSON line per test and a status line, then quits or stays up 15 s for the next run. The launcher, `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`, builds a mod's `<Mod>.Tests` project, checks it with `tools/ModCheck`, sets the enabled mods in `mods.json`, starts the game through Steam (or hands the run to a game already up with the same loadout) and prints a line per test. Tests compile against the test kit, `Isochronous.TestKit` in `Kit/`, and drive the game the way a player does. Without its arguments the mod does nothing, so it stays installed. The mod developer and the agents working on ONI-Mods use it: every mod's `src/<ModName>.Tests/` project runs through it.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-b5f287049a7f

Top-level folders and key files:

- `Mod.cs`: the `UserMod2` entry point. Reads the command line, turns the crash dialog off for a run and resolves test assemblies against the mods under test.
- `Session.cs`: the options, the discovered tests, the counters, the results and status files, and the live-session queue.
- `TestBehaviour.cs`: steps each test's coroutine by hand with a real-time deadline, captures errors the game logs and runs cleanups.
- `Patches.cs`: the Harmony patches that start a run from the main menu, block saves outside the run folder, skip autosave, suppress the mod and game-over dialogs and force the focus flags.
- `Harness.cs`: the run-wide switches: focus forced on, mouse locked, physical keyboard and mouse ignored, instant build, speed 1.
- `FixtureArea.cs`: picks the 40x10 test area in the fixture world and clears it before and after each test.
- `Worldgen.cs`: runs `[OniTest(Worldgen = ...)]` tests in a world freshly generated from a coordinate.
- `Reflect.cs`: every private game member the harness and kit read, with the self-check; `Diagnostics.cs`: the grid-mark trace behind `-Trace`.
- `Kit/`: the test kit (`Attributes.cs`, `TestContext.cs`, `OniAssert.cs`, `World.cs`, `Tools.cs`, `Dupes.cs`, `SaveFile.cs`).
- `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`: the launcher. `Watch-OniGame.ps1`: the warden that puts `mods.json` back and removes the live-session folder after the game exits.
- `fixtures/`: `testbed-so.sav`, the Spaced Out fixture save and the only test save tracked in git, and `README.md` on what makes a good fixture. The base-game fixture the launcher looks for, `testbed-base.sav`, is not in the repo.
- `TestRunner.csproj`: imports `oni-mod.props` and `oni-mod.targets` from the root of common; `mod.yaml` and `mod_info.yaml` beside it.
- `README.md`: running the launcher and its options, writing tests, the output and how it works.
- `runs/`: one folder per run (`<label>-<stamp>`) with the results, `Player.log`, the fixture copy and the checked DLLs; ignored by git.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-a5a05cca59dd

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-48bf49a3a8d9

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file, including `Kit/`.
- Four spaces in `Invoke-OniTests.ps1` and `Watch-OniGame.ps1`; two spaces in `TestRunner.csproj` and the yaml files.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-d5d494815e7f

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces (`if (!Session.Active)` followed by `return;` in `Mod.cs`).
- A `switch` case with one short statement stays on one line (`Session.ReadCommandLine`).

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-c5dee5000810

- No limit and no `.editorconfig`. Long log lines wrap before a `+` with the continuation indented one tab (the start-up `Debug.Log` in `Mod.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-827b53b95cbe

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8, built against the game's assemblies (`common/oni-mod.props` and `oni-mod.targets`). `TestRunner.csproj` sets `ReferenceUnityUI` and references `UnityEngine.ScreenCaptureModule` for `t.Screenshot`.
- The tool is a mod (`mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`, `TestRunnerMod : UserMod2`) and also a library: a mod's test project references `TestRunner.csproj` for the kit. A successful build deploys it to `Documents\Klei\OxygenNotIncluded\mods\local\TestRunner`.
- Two namespaces: `Isochronous.TestRunner` for the harness (the code that runs a session) and `Isochronous.TestKit` for what a test author uses (`Kit/`: the test context, assertions, attributes, dupes, tools, world helpers). Harness types a test may touch are public; the rest is `internal`.
- Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces. PowerShell is run with `pwsh`.

## Layout
**Id:** blk-3eafd0a33a08

| Path | Holds |
|------|-------|
| `Mod.cs` | `TestRunnerMod`: command line at load, crash-reporter flags, assembly resolve, quit tracing |
| `Session.cs` | `Session` (command line, test discovery, results, live-session queue), `TestCase`, `TestResult`, `Json` |
| `TestBehaviour.cs` | the driver that steps each test, `LogCapture` |
| `Patches.cs` | the Harmony patches |
| `Harness.cs` | the global switches a run throws |
| `FixtureArea.cs` | choosing and clearing the test area |
| `Worldgen.cs` | tests in a generated world |
| `Reflect.cs` | the private game members the kit and tests touch |
| `Diagnostics.cs` | opt-in grid-mark tracing |
| `Kit/` | the test kit |
| `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`, `Watch-OniGame.ps1` | launcher and warden |
| `fixtures/` | fixture saves and their README |

## Inert Without the Argument
**Id:** blk-2fc671d7925c

Every patch starts with `if (!Session.Active) ...`. `Session.Active` is true only with both `--onitest-dir` and `--onitest-save`. The mod stays installed and changes nothing in a normal game session.

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-bb5bf3709593

- One static class per patched method, named `<Type>_<Method>_Patch`, with `Prefix` or `Postfix` (`Patches.cs`); trace patches in `Diagnostics.cs` are named `_Trace`.
- Overloads are pinned by parameter types (`BuildingDef.TryPlace` in `Diagnostics.cs`).
- A patch that might not exist on another game build is applied by hand in try/catch (`TestRunnerMod.TracePatch`).

## Private Game Members
**Id:** blk-7ca12f96cdb9

The kit and the tests reach game internals only through `Reflect.cs`: a `public static readonly FieldInfo` per member from `AccessTools`, with a `///` summary saying what it is for, and a line in `Reflect.SelfCheck()`. `FieldInfo` is used and `FieldRefAccess` is not, because a `FieldRef` dynamic method cannot be built on the CoreCLR host that ModCheck runs on.

The harness has two exceptions. `Worldgen.cs` reads `CharacterSelectionController.proceedButton` and `WattsonMessage.button` with its own `AccessTools.Field` calls (`ProceedButton`, `WattsonButton`), and `SelfCheck` does not list them. `Mod.cs` resolves `App.Restart` and `Application.Quit` with `AccessTools.Method` for the quit trace, applied by hand through `TracePatch`. TODO(owner): move the two `Worldgen.cs` fields into `Reflect.cs` and `SelfCheck`.

## Comments
**Id:** blk-2536019dd87f

- Types, patches and switches get a `///` summary giving the purpose and, where a failure shaped the code, what failed (the settle before a reload in `TestBehaviour`, the focus patches in `Patches.cs`).
- Options are documented in three places that change together: the `///` summary of `Session`, the launcher's comment-based help and `README.md`.
- Kit members that a test author calls carry a summary written for that author.
- No commented-out code.

## Related
**Id:** blk-657b3eb1a17f

- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

sections.text:
## Layout
**Id:** blk-3eafd0a33a08

| Path | Holds |
|------|-------|
| `Mod.cs` | `TestRunnerMod`: command line at load, crash-reporter flags, assembly resolve, quit tracing |
| `Session.cs` | `Session` (command line, test discovery, results, live-session queue), `TestCase`, `TestResult`, `Json` |
| `TestBehaviour.cs` | the driver that steps each test, `LogCapture` |
| `Patches.cs` | the Harmony patches |
| `Harness.cs` | the global switches a run throws |
| `FixtureArea.cs` | choosing and clearing the test area |
| `Worldgen.cs` | tests in a generated world |
| `Reflect.cs` | the private game members the kit and tests touch |
| `Diagnostics.cs` | opt-in grid-mark tracing |
| `Kit/` | the test kit |
| `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`, `Watch-OniGame.ps1` | launcher and warden |
| `fixtures/` | fixture saves and their README |

sections.title: Inert Without the Argument
sections.text:
## Inert Without the Argument
**Id:** blk-2fc671d7925c

Every patch starts with `if (!Session.Active) ...`. `Session.Active` is true only with both `--onitest-dir` and `--onitest-save`. The mod stays installed and changes nothing in a normal game session.

sections.title: Harmony Patches
sections.text:
## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-bb5bf3709593

- One static class per patched method, named `<Type>_<Method>_Patch`, with `Prefix` or `Postfix` (`Patches.cs`); trace patches in `Diagnostics.cs` are named `_Trace`.
- Overloads are pinned by parameter types (`BuildingDef.TryPlace` in `Diagnostics.cs`).
- A patch that might not exist on another game build is applied by hand in try/catch (`TestRunnerMod.TracePatch`).

sections.title: Private Game Members
sections.text:
## Private Game Members
**Id:** blk-7ca12f96cdb9

The kit and the tests reach game internals only through `Reflect.cs`: a `public static readonly FieldInfo` per member from `AccessTools`, with a `///` summary saying what it is for, and a line in `Reflect.SelfCheck()`. `FieldInfo` is used and `FieldRefAccess` is not, because a `FieldRef` dynamic method cannot be built on the CoreCLR host that ModCheck runs on.

The harness has two exceptions. `Worldgen.cs` reads `CharacterSelectionController.proceedButton` and `WattsonMessage.button` with its own `AccessTools.Field` calls (`ProceedButton`, `WattsonButton`), and `SelfCheck` does not list them. `Mod.cs` resolves `App.Restart` and `Application.Quit` with `AccessTools.Method` for the quit trace, applied by hand through `TracePatch`. TODO(owner): move the two `Worldgen.cs` fields into `Reflect.cs` and `SelfCheck`.

sections.title: Comments
sections.text:
## Comments
**Id:** blk-2536019dd87f

- Types, patches and switches get a `///` summary giving the purpose and, where a failure shaped the code, what failed (the settle before a reload in `TestBehaviour`, the focus patches in `Patches.cs`).
- Options are documented in three places that change together: the `///` summary of `Session`, the launcher's comment-based help and `README.md`.
- Kit members that a test author calls carry a summary written for that author.
- No commented-out code.
